name: snowcorpse necromancy
source:
15k words on two bunnies trying to survive the permafrost of NAOMIDA; they are sister and brother, daughter and mother, owner and doll.

[From [url=https://nadianova.neocities.org/snowromancy]the official site[/url]]
translation:
一部约1.5万词的故事。两只兔子试图在NAOMIDA的永久冻土上活下去。这两只兔子既是姐弟，又是母女，也是主人与玩偶。

［摘自[url=https://nadianova.neocities.org/snowromancy]官方网站[/url]］
